editorial_review.baseline_reference: Saved core_stories.py LLM preview text is included verbatim per matchup. This is a six-example editorial comparison, not a blinded human preference study.
editorial_review.headline_choice: For all six complete-record fixtures, team stories were fixed before player stats: record form, undefeated, winless/last place, top four, or streak clash.
remaining_gaps: Templates have only been reviewed on six matchups.
Playoff races, rivalries, and rematches without a source-backed result need fixtures.
The player thresholds can still choose a different star than the LLM baseline; review Houston and Portland.
Historical NFL standings need an archived cutoff-safe snapshot for database-only replay at this cutoff.
Production integration remains untouched pending editorial review.
